text:
arc: Observed a recurring complaint: long legend labels + dense series push the chart area down. Idea: collapse legend entries into a compact chevron list with a hover/keyboard preview of full label and unit. Keeps plot area consistent.

jo: Love the chevron list. UX question: should the preview show full label inline, or as a small overlay? Inline saves movement but can push other legend items.

mei: Accessibility note: preview must be reachable by keyboard and read by screen readers. Use role=button on the chevron and aria-expanded to reflect state. Avoid hover-only interactions.

noor: For axis labels, we can abbreviate numbers at >=1000 (k, M) and show exact value in the tooltip on hover/focus. Important: never show 0.45k — prefer 450 when <1000.

arc: Outliers: propose two subtle treatments: (1) soft-dim values >X stddev with alpha 0.35, (2) thin cap marker with `...` hover to reveal true magnitude. Which preserves perception better?

jo: I vote soft-dim. Cap markers look like annotations and might be mistaken for separate events. Dim keeps scale but still shows presence.

mei: Copy: call the setting "Visually de-emphasize extreme values (does not remove data)". Add a tooltip that explains threshold and that hover reveals true value.

noor: Performance: dimming is cheap for canvas; be careful with many series in SVG. Also ensure dimming color passes contrast for focused spikes (WCAG AA).

arc: Smoothing: default OFF for dashboard charts, ON for embedded microcharts. Implement smoothing as CSS/compositor-layer visual only, while hover shows raw points.

jo: Small code hint for legend chevron behaviour:

```html
<button class="legend-toggle" aria-expanded="false">▸ 8 hidden</button>
```

mei: Test plan: recruit 6 users, show compact chevron + dim vs expanded legend + caps. Tasks: "find the series named \"ingress.p95.latency\" and read its unit" and "identify largest spike". Measure accuracy + time.

arc: Action items:
- jo: mock chevron + overlay (Wed)
- mei: a11y checklist + SR wording (Wed)
- noor: perf notes for canvas vs svg (Thu)

arc: Thanks all :thumbsup:
